original_row: | `E4-SCHEMA-CE-049` | SEEDED | Typed annotation lookup is sufficient for effectful-field admission, so malformed and duplicate raw occurrences may be filtered away | `Test/Counterexamples/Schema/EffectfulField.lean`, one duplicate-valid bag and one malformed-plus-valid bag | derive admission from the exact raw `Annotations.payloadsAt` occurrence list; require one canonical payload and reject every other multiplicity or malformed spelling |

| `E4-SCHEMA-CE-050` | SEEDED | Equal read and write operation numbers identify an effectful field across alphabets | `Test/Counterexamples/Schema/EffectfulField.lean`, `operations` versus `otherAlphabet` | require alphabet, read-operation, and write-operation identities to agree; attach no service or refusal meaning at this layer |

| `E4-SCHEMA-CE-051` | SEEDED | Effectful `modify` may transform `Lens.get source` and skip its declared read operation | `Test/Counterexamples/Schema/EffectfulField.lean`, `field.modify` starts at `Op.read` while `staleModify` starts at `Op.write 11` | generate `modify` as effectful read followed by write and local replacement; the source lens value is not the read result |

| `E4-SCHEMA-CE-052` | SEEDED | Effectful `set` may return the pure lens replacement without performing the declared write | `Test/Counterexamples/Schema/EffectfulField.lean`, root operation of `field.set` versus the pure replacement program | perform the existing signature operation before returning the lens-replaced source and prove the same order through interpretation |

| `E4-SCHEMA-CE-053` | SEEDED | An effectful-field marker on a representation node marks an object property | `Test/Counterexamples/Schema/EffectfulFieldProperties.lean`, `nodeOnly` versus `propertyOnly` | inspect only the existing `PropertySignatureOf.annotations` bag for direct discovery; node, check, element, and property-type annotations do not mark the property |

| `E4-SCHEMA-CE-054` | SEEDED | Scanning only the current object's property list inventories effectful fields recursively | `Test/Counterexamples/Schema/EffectfulFieldProperties.lean`, `recursiveWitness` with fourteen exact discoveries through object properties, property types, index positions, arrays, templates, unions, suspend, and both check-schema routes | derive one collector from the existing fold (`cata_representation`; `Representation.fold` until 2026-09-17); preserve the fold's structural preorder and reuse its closed recursion proof graph |

| `E4-SCHEMA-CE-055` | SEEDED | A map or set is an adequate effectful-field inventory because property names identify occurrences | `Test/Counterexamples/Schema/EffectfulFieldProperties.lean`, the two stored `duplicate` properties retain read-operation identities `21` then `31` | return an ordered list of the existing full property paired with its existing spec; preserve duplicate names, multiplicity, pairing, and authored order |

| `E4-SCHEMA-CE-018` | SEEDED | A Lean constructor name determines the persisted `_tag` spelling | `Test/Counterexamples/Schema/WireSpellingDrift.lean` | pin the case-sensitive wire string per tag and prove injectivity plus a partial inverse |

| `E4-SCHEMA-CE-019` | SEEDED | `census.length = 22` establishes the census | `Test/Counterexamples/Schema/CensusCoverage.lean`, `decoyCensus` with 22 entries, one repeat, one omission | require length, duplicate freedom, and coverage as three separate theorems, coverage by case analysis |

| `E4-SCHEMA-CE-020` | SEEDED | Enum member values and literal payloads may share one kind alphabet | `Test/Counterexamples/Schema/KindAlphabetSeparation.lean` | keep `EnumValueKind` and `LiteralKind` separate and relate them by an explicit non-surjective kind-level embedding |

| `E4-SCHEMA-CE-021` | SEEDED | `null` is a persisted literal payload kind | compile-negative in `Test/Counterexamples/Schema/NoNullLiteralKind.lean`, plus the 4-entry census | enforce the exclusion by absent constructor, not by a later admission rule; keep the `Null` representation tag distinct |

| `E4-SCHEMA-CE-022` | SEEDED | Object property keys may include live-only local symbols | compile-negative in `Test/Counterexamples/Schema/NoLocalSymbolPropertyKey.lean`, plus the 3-entry census | admit only string, number, and global-symbol keys; necessary condition for reserved `E4-SCHEMA-CE-010`, not a discharge |

| `E4-SCHEMA-CE-043` | SEEDED | Traversing direct `Representation` children and `FilterGroup.checks` is a complete general recursion over the payload family | `Test/Counterexamples/Schema/RecursiveElimination.lean`: a root with one filter and one nested annotation schema has shallow trace `[String, Filter]` and complete trace `[String, Filter, Number]`; the twelve-label witness gives every recursive route a distinct observation, detecting omission, duplication, and reordering | expose one two-sorted nondependent fold whose algebra receives recursively substituted `CheckRepresentationAnnotationOf`, `ElementOf`, `PropertySignatureOf`, and `IndexSignatureOf` values, plus mapped representation/check lists; retain all 24 public constructor equations and both rebuild identity theorems |

| `E4-SCHEMA-CE-044` | SEEDED | A `Reference` with no annotation field is indistinguishable from a node whose present annotation field stores `none` | `Test/Counterexamples/Schema/AnnotationDataPlane.lean`, `collapsedNodeAnnotations` and `no_focus_ne_present_none` | expose `Representation.nodeAnnotations` as an `Optional`: `Reference` has no focus, while every other node has `some annotations`, including `some none` |

| `E4-SCHEMA-CE-045` | SEEDED | Looking up the first annotation key, or first collapsing the bag to a map, is enough for annotation updates | `Test/Counterexamples/Schema/AnnotationDataPlane.lean`, three ordered duplicate `k` entries around an unrelated entry | keep `Annotations` as the existing optional ordered list and make `payloadsAt` visit and update every matching payload in place without reordering, deduplicating, or touching unrelated entries |

| `E4-SCHEMA-CE-046` | SEEDED | `decode (encode value) = some value` is sufficient for an exact typed annotation view | `Test/Counterexamples/Schema/AnnotationDataPlane.lean`, `canonicalUnit` decodes every string but re-encodes `"authored-spelling"` as `"canonical"` | require both `decode_encode` and `encode_decode`; prove `entry_of_decodeEntry` so identity modification reconstructs the exact existing `AnnotationEntry` without a second Schema carrier |

| `E4-SCHEMA-CE-047` | SEEDED | Traversing only node annotation fields covers the recursive annotation data plane | `Test/Counterexamples/Schema/AnnotationDataPlane.lean`, `nestedRoutes`: the shallow result is `[arrays]`, while the exact nine-label result includes group/filter schemas, nested checks, an element bag and type, and a property bag and type | derive `Representation.annotationBags` and `Check.annotationBags` from the closed two-sorted fold; preserve structural preorder across every recursive route and every annotation-bearing child record |

| `E4-SCHEMA-CE-048` | SEEDED | A document annotation traversal may follow resolved or reachable references and skip the rest of the reference table | `Test/Counterexamples/Schema/AnnotationDataPlane.lean`, a root with no references plus three dead entries, including a duplicate key | traverse the root(s), then every `ReferenceEntry.representation` in stored list order; do not resolve keys or filter dead, duplicate, dangling, or unreachable entries in the structural data plane |

| `E4-SCHEMA-CE-056` | PINNED | Every typed natural round-trips through binary64 JSON | `Test/Counterexamples/Schema/Codec.lean`, `natural_collision` and `natural_roundTrip_impossible`: 2^53 and 2^53+1 have the same image | owner amendment 2026-09-11: check exact value recovery before accepting an encoding |

| `E4-SCHEMA-CE-057` | PINNED | Ordinary subtyping alone guarantees identical JSON encodings | `Test/Counterexamples/Schema/Codec.lean`, `subtype_encoding_impossible`: one constructor is both Result Failure and Exit Success, each a subtype of their union | require a shared JSON layout in addition to subtyping and membership |

| `E4-SCHEMA-CE-058` | PINNED | Every value admitted as a list is an ordinary list | `Test/Counterexamples/Schema/Codec.lean`, `snapshot_has_list_bool`, `snapshot_not_list`, and `list_totality_impossible`: empty fiber snapshot is admitted but has a distinct carrier | JSON value admission excludes snapshots; do not flatten away their identity |
